text:
Nina (oncall): Alerting team 1:15 UTC: noticed a spike of streaming resets and 429s for /v1/stream endpoints in eu-west-1. Impact: ~1.8% of streaming requests experiencing early resets, customer-visible for long-lived sessions. Declaring incident. Severity: S3. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2145012345

ops-bot: metric-alert: stream_reset_rate_high eu-west-1 threshold 1.0% breached at 21:15:07 (value=1.82%).

Matt: I'm sampling session traces now. Early signal: token-bucket exhaustion on the new adaptive rate-limiter canary (adaptive-rl:v1-canary).

Riya: We just rolled adaptive-rl to 10% canary at 20:50 UTC. Canary config excerpt: `burst=500, refill_rate=250/s, per_tenant=false`. I'm pausing canary deployment to stop further rollout. Command: `infractl rollout pause --id adaptive-rl --canary`

deploy-bot: rollout pause acknowledged for adaptive-rl at 21:17:12 UTC.

Matt: Temporary mitigation applied: exempt long-lived streams (>30s) from token accounting. Command used: `curl -XPOST "https://infra-api/configs/adaptive-rl/exempt" -d '{"predicate":"session_duration>30s"}'` (internal only). After exemption, reset rate dropped from 1.82% -> 0.34% in 3 minutes.

Telemetry: p95 stream latency unaffected; reset reason tag shows `rate_limiter:token_depleted` in 78% of sampled traces. Attaching quick query: `sum(rate(stream_resets_total{region="eu-west-1"}[1m])) by (reason)`

CustomerOps: Notifying impacted customers via private channel. Draft update: "We observed resets on long-running streaming sessions in eu-west-1 due to a canary rate-limiter config. We've paused the canary and applied a temporary exemption. We're investigating and will follow up with an RCA."

Nina (oncall): Good. Next steps: Riya to produce config diff and rollback plan, Matt to collect detailed traces and a repro script, Telemetry to supply time-series and per-tenant hit rates. We'll run a 30m post-incident review at 22:00 UTC.

Riya: Plan is to rollback canary to previous stable limiter (adaptive-rl:v0.9) in the canary pool and re-run canary with per-tenant limits and lower burst. Follow-ups: add canary throttling guard that auto-pauses on >0.5% user-visible errors.

Matt: Quick repro notes for the postmortem: start 5 parallel long-lived streams from a single tenant at t=0, observe token bucket drain within ~22s for current canary config. Will add script to incident doc.

Nina (oncall): Current status: mitigated (temporary exemption in place, canary paused). Monitoring for 1 hour. Incident state: mitigated. RCA owners: Riya (config), Matt (traces/repro), Telemetry (dashboards).

CustomerOps: Status page updated to: "Partial degradation for streaming in eu-west-1; temporary mitigation applied." Link to customer update: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2145012345

Nina (oncall): Closing thread unless we see recurrence. Thanks all.
